headline: Your project as a poster, in words anyone can read.

figure.fits: A sieve: jargon, file paths and crowded text stay caught in the bowl, and only plain words fall through its holes as grains below.

texts.text: **Caught.** Jargon, file paths and text that runs into the picture stay in the sieve.
**Through.** Only plain words reach the poster.

notes.title: How it works
notes.text: Vyo reads your project and draws its parts as a picture. It checks every word around the picture, then writes a PNG and a PDF.

notes.title: What stays out
notes.text: Jargon, file paths and text that runs into the picture fail the check. Vyo names what to fix, and the check keeps failing until nothing is caught.

notes.title: Reading the picture
notes.text: The bowl holds what the check catches. What falls through is what reaches your poster, in plain words anyone can read.
